limits: The p145 source explicitly has 183 typed coordinates in part2 and advertises184; the short XFVA group is preserved literally and its added F is a frame hypothesis supported by the independent p211 copy.

The copies have different date/header layers. Both use the unchanged published Nov4–6 key; this evidence does not justify normalizing dates or claiming that all stations followed the December schedule.
References and labels remain source-specific: p145 NACHRCHEFXG and NACHRCHEFX4 are not replaced by p211 NACHRCHEFX4 and NACHRCHEFZ4.
The already published p211 body and earlier key recovery retain credit. These are additional source witnesses, not new first-solution claims.
